## Purpose

Describe the recipe, mapping or correction and its intended users.

## Contract and access

- Exact Core compatibility and independent package version (if code changes).
- Provider read scope, identity, fields mapped and fields deliberately omitted.
- Any changed registration or feed consent; recipes remain inert.
- Synthetic fixtures only; no private provider data or credentials.

## Evidence

List focused build, typecheck and test commands with results. State missing scenarios and release
prerequisites. Source review does not enable an integration in CLI or hosted execution.
